source: Procedural transparent Lost Site Expedition foreground depth pack generated 2026-05-29 and extended with reusable contact aliases 2026-06-01 to ground large Egypt structures without replacing artwork.
mappingNote: Transparent visual-only foreground source assets for terrain-level framing: rubble clusters, sand drifts, archaeological remains, desert vegetation, low drifting dust, reusable ground-skirt aliases, and contact shadow overlays for structure bases. No collision data, no gameplay rules, and does not replace existing artwork. Runtime placement should avoid tall ghosted edge cutouts and favor subtle bottom-edge sediment that blends into the playable sand.

egyptGroundSkirtLong.purpose: long reusable sand skirt for embedding wide Egypt structures without ground haze

egyptGroundSkirtShort.purpose: short sand skirt for smaller thresholds and exits

egyptBaseSandDrift.purpose: soft sand drift that can overlap a building base

egyptRubbleContactShadow.purpose: low rubble and dark edge detail for a structure contact shadow

egyptBuriedStoneEdge.purpose: buried cracked stone edge and masonry fragments at a building base

egyptStructureBaseRubble.purpose: larger reusable rubble mass for structure footings and climb supports
